narrative: Both the Flowise custom-MCP RCE and the AutoGen Studio host-process code execution stem from a trust-the-authenticated-user, run-on-the-host pattern that a deny-by-default capability gate is designed to foreclose, while Claude Sonnet 5 ships stronger prompt-injection resistance. Together they raise the pressure for such a gate, feeding the precondition this prediction builds on.
remaining_gap: No coding-agent platform has shipped the default-on gate capping the private-data, untrusted-content, and external-communication trifecta, so the relevance stays thematic.
